artist.name: Tarqeeb
artist.bio: Tarqeeb is a DJ and producer from Mumbai who started the project in 2012. His sets range from meditative dubstep and jungle to Indian electronica, and he hosted the monthly show Juggernaut on boxout.fm, showcasing Indian electronica. He is part of the six-person artist collective DASTA.

eras.sound: Deep sub-bass, dubstep and jungle to Indian electronica
